item.title: Allam concedes NC Congressional District 4 Democratic primary to incumbent Foushee
item.description: After a close race in the Democratic primary for North Carolina Congressional District 4, challenger Nida Allam said she is conceding to incumbent Valerie Foushee despite the margin of difference being eligible for a recount.
